run_sft_training: run supervised fine-tuning of a decoder language model using accelerate launch with a dataset and model path
run_sft_with_peft: run parameter-efficient fine-tuning of a language model using PEFT config and gradient checkpointing
run_sft_resume_checkpoint: resume supervised fine-tuning training from the last checkpoint in the output directory
run_sft_eval_and_push: run supervised fine-tuning with evaluation strategy and push the trained model to the HuggingFace hub
run_sft_chatml_format: run supervised fine-tuning that automatically applies ChatML chat format when no template is provided
